Guidance & outlook: So, in addition to the work that I updated you all last quarter around infections, robotic surgeries, and modern treatments, there's also work and we expect to roll out in collaboration with the association of, you know, ocular group, our position statements on cancer, and we are also working at a fairly advanced stage as far as position statements on oncolo…
So that's, that's broadly what we are driving, and, we do expect to sustain 8 to 10 percentage points faster than market growth on retail health specifically.
And on that, we stick to our FY29 guidance, which is what we have been indicating.
Growth & demand: Retail health at the industry level grew 31.6% and the overall growth as far as health is concerned, you know, on a reported basis was 22.4%.
As far as Niva Bupa's performance is concerned, on a like-to-like basis, overall we grew at 23.0%; on a reported basis at 31.7%.
And our retail market share, which is only available on a reported basis, has moved up to 11.1% for Q1.
Margins & costs: Just a brief comment that we have seen a challenging pricing environment on the group side.
And the pricing environment that we discussed last year as well, specifically towards Q3, Q4, we continue to face a challenging pricing environment on the B2B side.

Firstly, if I look at your claims ratio that has improved by more than 300 basis points, and obviously we had m ultiple levers here with respect to fresh growth being stronger, pricing actions being taken.
Capex & expansion: For example, let's say, in some cases, the profit commission, which is mainly on obligatory or voluntary quota share, is booked in one quarter, in some time it is in next quarter.
Actually, in case of GST, as far as commission is concerned, which is the main line item that we have already passed on to our distributors.
So this year as well, in terms of distribution expansion, we continue to have the same level of investment, although incrementally it's much smaller given the size of the company today.
Balance sheet & cash: We start with; the board has approved formation of debt raising committee and it has also passed enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crore s in one or more tranches.
And we're also looking at our growth plans for next 2 years, and basis that we will take decision to raise debt.

Guidance & outlook: And on commission, Supratim to your point, we await guidance from the authority in terms of how they would like to move forward.
So, we are confident that whatever the authority comes up with we will make sure that the distribution is appropriately remunerated for the efforts that they make.
And in terms of target, I don't think we want to target the claims ratio that operates below where we are because you also have to understand that there has to be value to customers.
Growth & demand: Indeed, now with the benefit of the entire H2 behind us, the retail health growth, if you looked at H2 for the industry was about 30%.
And with Niva Bupa, our retail health growth for the same period was in excess of 40%.
Overall growth for the organization was 35% and volume growth out of this is 24%.
Margins & costs: All of these initiatives help bring about higher transparency and standardization of care, of care pathways and claims cost is embedded in these care pathways.
